meta.description: Research Summaries: research explained by the next generation of researchers.

hero.h1: Research explained by the next generation of researchers
hero.lead: Students and early-career researchers contribute an accessible summary of a scientific paper they have studied.
hero.note: You do not need to be a Research Fellow to contribute.

contribute.body: Have you studied a paper and want to explain it simply? Send us your summary. The GAMA team reviews it with you before publication.
contribute.tpl_body: 5-part structure, 500 to 900 words, writing rules and tips for visuals: it is all in the writing guide.
includes: The summary author and their institution
The reference to the original paper
